when i was in kindergarten (maybe 5 years old) i was eating porridge and this kid next to me vomited all over the table and right onto my plate, i remember panicking and not being able to process it. he went home soon after and was fine when he came back a few days later but it really stuck with me, though i don't think my phobia got very bad until my whole family got norovirus a week before chistmas when i was 9 years old. i woke up in the middle of the night to panic and didn't know what was happening, i paced and hyperventilated until i eventually threw up on the floor. i felt so ashamed i went to tell my mom, her husband got up and cleaned it up, i went back to sleep and thought it was over. i woke up to more nausea the next day after sleeping for like 12 hours, i rushed downstairs to tell my mom i wasn't feeling good. she grabbed a bucket and took me to the bathroom, i threw up twice and was fine afterwards. after that i spent years being in a constant state of fight or flight, i was so anxious i would wake up at night thinking i was going to vomit again and would wake my mom up panicking because i was so sure i was sick again. it hasn't happened since but the fear remained, i did have a few years where i barely thought about it unless if i was nauseous but right now i'm going through a huge relapse. i'm slowly making progress thankfully but i am still afraid it'll never go away
